name: asks
about: This conversation's requests and their current state.

name: answer_ask
about: Allow one identical retry, or decline the request.

name: conversations
about: The conversations, the running ones first, then pinned, then the newest, each with its state in plain words (`working`, `waiting`, `idle`; read one conversation for how it ended). `state` keeps only these states (`running` is working or waiting); `archived` true lists only archived ones and false every one; `family` keeps the family of a conversation (who started whom); `query` keeps titles holding its words. Reads no conversation's messages.

name: conversation
about: One conversation: its state (`concluded` only when its AI concluded the whole request), its last `last` messages (all when missing) with the tools each used, and the AI's latest conclusion. Unlike opening it on the screen, reading it leaves its done mark for the person.

name: results
about: What a conversation delivered and what it cost, after its first reply.

name: project_results
about: A project's total and each conversation's results, most spent first.

name: projects
about: The projects Faber knows, with their folders.

name: quota
about: Each vendor's quota windows (how much is used, when each resets) and what Faber has spent of them.

name: settings
about: The settings as Settings shows them.

name: continue_closed
about: Go on with a reply Faber was closed under (R477): one fixed turn, refused once it is no longer the last.

name: cli_sessions
about: The sessions started in a terminal in a project's folder (parity F5).

name: pick_up
about: Opens a session started in a terminal as a project conversation, or the one already opened for it.

name: branch_here
about: "Branch from here" on an answer: a new conversation with every message up to it, where nothing is sent yet.

name: versions
about: The messages of a conversation that have other versions; the other conversations of its family are read from disk.

name: visual_answers
about: Pages and drawings, with the versions already held in the conversation's saved replies.

name: answer_question
about: The person's choices for a question the agent asked: each question's text to the label picked.

name: archive
about: Archives a conversation, or brings an archived one back.

name: child_words
about: What a subagent wrote between its steps (R161 step 3), for its side chat while it is open. The screen's copy of a message carries only their length, so this is the one place they are read.

name: mentions
about: `@` in the composer (parity T4): the entries of the working folder that match `query`, at most 50. Git may run, off the async threads. One listing runs at a time, and a query that a newer one replaced while it waited gives up, so typing fast in a big repository never piles up git runs or their output.

name: commands
about: The last advertised commands, read from memory without starting a CLI.

name: compact_now
about: "Compact now" in the context meter: the CLI's own compaction of the conversation's context.

name: context_parts
about: The context meter opened: asks what fills the context; the parts come as an event. False when no CLI can say now.

name: changes
about: At most one git listing runs and one waits; a newer request replaces the waiting one.

name: ask_aside
about: A quick question on the side of a conversation (R250); `model` is the tab's own pick, or the conversation's.

name: unfollow_pr
about: The person stops following the pull request a project conversation follows (R200).

name: save_settings
about: A theme file comes from other people, so an appearance is checked here before anything is saved.

name: conversation_markdown
about: The same readable record as the file export, without writing a file.

name: recents
about: The recent folders and saved environments, judged now: a folder that is gone or refused carries a reason key.

name: save_file
about: Copies a file from a chat workspace to wherever the user picks.

name: show_project
about: Shows a project's folder in the file manager. The saved path is checked first (folder.rs), and the folder is only revealed, never opened: if something else took its place, the file manager selects it and starts nothing.

name: read_file_at
about: A file a reply names, read only around its line (parity P2), from inside the conversation's folder.

name: read_image
about: An image from a chat workspace as a data URL, so the page never reads the disk itself.

name: site_tabs
about: A conversation's tabs in Faber's browser, kept in its file, so the pane opens the front one again.

name: site_picture
about: The picture the browser took for a call, as a data URL, so the page never reads the disk itself.

name: open_link
about: Links in answers open in the user's browser, never inside Faber.

name: project_copies
about: Settings > Projects: whether each new conversation of this project works in a separate copy (R201).

name: project_goals
about: Settings > Projects and the project page's Goals fold: a project's standing goals, the switch and the day's limit.

name: project_goals_auto
about: The project's switch for starting fixes by itself. Off until the person turns it on.

name: project_goal_add
about: Adds a goal: the person's words and one of the project's confirmed checks.

name: project_goal_add_crashes
about: Adds a goal that breaks when the installed Faber's crash file gets a new line: Faber's own repository only.

name: project_goal_resume
about: A paused goal, or one that needs the person, is checked again.

name: project_proof_confirm
about: The owner confirms the commands Faber checks a project's work with (R137): the project's declared list, or the edited one.

name: update_status
about: The screen's view of the update: its phase and the download's progress. Changes arrive as `faber:update`.

name: update_restart
about: "Update ready, restart": installs the kept update now. Work that runs is cut and goes on after the restart.

name: tools_in_use
about: The catalog tools a conversation's agent has now, each with its job group, for the context meter's panel: read from the engine's memory when the panel opens; nothing is prepared, polled or started.

name: show_conversation
about: Bring the window to a conversation.

name: cookie_profiles
about: The Firefox profiles on this computer whose sign-ins the browser pane can bring over.

name: cookie_sites
about: The sites with cookies in the profile `profile`, under a ticket the import names.

name: cookie_import
about: Brings the person's sign-ins on the sites they picked into conversation `id`'s pages; answers how many sites came over.

name: cookie_held
about: The sites whose sign-ins conversation `id` holds.

name: cookie_forget
about: Forgets the sign-ins conversation `id` holds and signs its page out of them.
